lines.raw: The idea in one sentence.
lines.say: The idea in one sentence.

lines.raw: A DRG grouper answers the same fixed questions for every hospital stay (which body system, was there an operation, how complicated was it) and the answers lead to exactly **one DRG**.
lines.say: A D R G grouper answers the same fixed questions for every hospital stay (which body system, was there an operation, how complicated was it) and the answers lead to exactly one D R G.

lines.raw: The US version: what the grouper reads.
lines.say: The U S version: what the grouper reads.

scenes.section: The US version: what the grouper reads

lines.raw: DRG (Diagnosis Related Group).
lines.say: D R G (Diagnosis Related Group).

lines.raw: A group of hospital stays that are clinically similar and use similar amounts of hospital resources.
lines.say: A group of hospital stays that are clinically similar and use similar amounts of hospital resources.

lines.raw: Medicare's version is the **MS-DRG** (Medicare Severity DRG).
lines.say: Medicare's version is the M S DRG (Medicare Severity D R G).

lines.raw: Principal diagnosis.
lines.say: Principal diagnosis.

lines.raw: The condition found, after study, to be the main reason the patient was admitted.
lines.say: The condition found, after study, to be the main reason the patient was admitted.

lines.raw: It drives most of the grouping.
lines.say: It drives most of the grouping.

lines.raw: Secondary diagnoses.
lines.say: Secondary diagnoses.

lines.raw: Other conditions present during the stay.
lines.say: Other conditions present during the stay.

lines.raw: Some count as complications or comorbidities (below).
lines.say: Some count as complications or comorbidities (below).

lines.raw: MDC (Major Diagnostic Category).
lines.say: M D C (Major Diagnostic Category).

lines.raw: A broad body-system group, for example the digestive system or the musculoskeletal system.
lines.say: A broad body-system group, for example the digestive system or the musculoskeletal system.

lines.raw: MS-DRG has 25 of them.
lines.say: M S DRG has 25 of them.

lines.raw: OR procedure.
lines.say: O R procedure.

lines.raw: An ICD-10-PCS procedure the grouper treats as an operating room procedure.
lines.say: An I C D 10-PCS procedure the grouper treats as an operating room procedure.

lines.raw: It makes the stay **surgical**; otherwise it is **medical**.
lines.say: It makes the stay surgical; otherwise it is medical.

lines.raw: CC (complication or comorbidity).
lines.say: C C (complication or comorbidity).

lines.raw: A secondary diagnosis that usually makes a stay need more care, such as acute kidney failure.
lines.say: A secondary diagnosis that usually makes a stay need more care, such as acute kidney failure.

lines.raw: MCC (major complication or comorbidity).
lines.say: M C C (major complication or comorbidity).

lines.raw: A secondary diagnosis that makes a stay need a lot more care, such as sepsis or acute respiratory failure.
lines.say: A secondary diagnosis that makes a stay need a lot more care, such as sepsis or acute respiratory failure.

lines.raw: The steps, in order.
lines.say: The steps, in order.

lines.raw: Step 1: Check for very costly procedures (pre-MDC).
lines.say: Step 1: Check for very costly procedures (pre-MDC).

lines.raw: A few procedures, such as organ transplants or long breathing-machine support with a tracheostomy, are grouped first, whatever the diagnosis.
lines.say: A few procedures, such as organ transplants or long breathing-machine support with a tracheostomy, are grouped first, whatever the diagnosis.

lines.raw: Step 2: Pick the MDC from the principal diagnosis.
lines.say: Step 2: Pick the M D C from the principal diagnosis.

lines.raw: Appendicitis goes to the digestive system MDC; knee arthritis to the musculoskeletal MDC.
lines.say: Appendicitis goes to the digestive system M D C; knee arthritis to the musculoskeletal M D C.

lines.raw: Step 3: Surgical or medical?
lines.say: Step 3: Surgical or medical?

lines.raw: If there is an OR procedure, the stay goes to the surgical side of the MDC; if not, the medical side.
lines.say: If there is an O R procedure, the stay goes to the surgical side of the M D C; if not, the medical side.

lines.raw: Step 4: Pick the base DRG.
lines.say: Step 4: Pick the base D R G.

lines.raw: On the surgical side, the main operation decides the family (for example "appendectomy").
lines.say: On the surgical side, the main operation decides the family (for example "appendectomy").

lines.raw: On the medical side, the principal diagnosis decides it (for example "pneumonia").
lines.say: On the medical side, the principal diagnosis decides it (for example "pneumonia").

lines.raw: Step 5: Split by severity.
lines.say: Step 5: Split by severity.

lines.raw: Secondary diagnoses are checked against the CC and MCC lists.
lines.say: Secondary diagnoses are checked against the C C and M C C lists.

lines.raw: A stay goes to the "with MCC", "with CC" or "without CC/MCC" DRG in its family.
lines.say: A stay goes to the "with M C C", "with C C" or "without CC/MCC" D R G in its family.

lines.raw: A CC closely related to the principal diagnosis is excluded, so the same problem is not counted twice.
lines.say: A C C closely related to the principal diagnosis is excluded, so the same problem is not counted twice.

lines.raw: Step 6: A few extra checks.
lines.say: Step 6: A few extra checks.

lines.raw: Some DRGs also use discharge status (for example, heart attack patients who died vs went home), and newborn DRGs use birth weight.
lines.say: Some D R G's also use discharge status (for example, heart attack patients who died versus went home), and newborn D R G's use birth weight.

lines.raw: What the DRG is worth is a separate step.
lines.say: What the D R G is worth is a separate step.

lines.raw: Each MS-DRG has a **relative weight** and an expected length of stay.
lines.say: Each M S DRG has a relative weight and an expected length of stay.

lines.raw: Turning the weight into a payment (base rate × weight, plus adjustments) is taught in the Fee For Service course.
lines.say: Turning the weight into a payment (base rate × weight, plus adjustments) is taught in the Fee For Service course.

lines.raw: The DRG field on the hospital claim is described in the Medical course.
lines.say: The D R G field on the hospital claim is described in the Medical course.

lines.raw: Present on admission (POA).
lines.say: Present on admission (P O A).

lines.raw: Every diagnosis on an inpatient claim carries a **POA (present on admission) indicator**: was the condition already there when the patient was admitted, or did it start in hospital?
lines.say: Every diagnosis on an inpatient claim carries a P O A (present on admission) indicator: was the condition already there when the patient was admitted, or did it start in hospital?

lines.raw: POA indicator values.
lines.say: P O A indicator values.

lines.raw: `Y`. Meaning: Yes, present when admitted.
lines.say: Y. Meaning: Yes, present when admitted.

lines.raw: `N`. Meaning: No, it started during the stay.
lines.say: N. Meaning: No, it started during the stay.

lines.raw: `U`. Meaning: Unknown: the records do not say.
lines.say: U. Meaning: Unknown: the records do not say.

lines.raw: `W`. Meaning: The doctor cannot tell clinically.
lines.say: W. Meaning: The doctor cannot tell clinically.

lines.raw: `1` or blank. Meaning: Exempt: the code does not need a POA flag.
lines.say: 1 or blank. Meaning: Exempt: the code does not need a P O A flag.

lines.raw: Hospital-acquired conditions do not raise the DRG.
lines.say: Hospital-acquired conditions do not raise the D R G.

lines.raw: Medicare keeps a list of **HACs (hospital-acquired conditions)**, such as a urinary infection from a catheter, a serious bedsore, or a blood clot after a knee or hip replacement.
lines.say: Medicare keeps a list of H A C's (hospital-acquired conditions), such as a urinary infection from a catheter, a serious bedsore, or a blood clot after a knee or hip replacement.

lines.raw: If an HAC is flagged `N` (or `U`), the grouper **ignores** it as a CC or MCC.
lines.say: If an H A C is flagged N (or U), the grouper ignores it as a C C or M C C.

lines.raw: A hospital should not be paid more because of a preventable problem that it caused.
lines.say: A hospital should not be paid more because of a preventable problem that it caused.

lines.say: Worked example: Emily's appendix stay three ways.

lines.raw: Emily (34, an office worker in Texas) was admitted on 2 June 2025 with acute appendicitis (`K35.80`), had keyhole removal of her appendix (`0DTJ4ZZ`), and went home on 4 June.
lines.say: Emily (34, an office worker in Texas) was admitted on 2 June 2025 with acute appendicitis (K 3 5 . 8 0), had keyhole removal of her appendix (0 D T J 4 Z Z), and went home on 4 June.

lines.raw: Here is how the grouper handles her real stay and two "what if" versions.
lines.say: Here is how the grouper handles her real stay and two "what if" versions.

scenes.section: Worked example: Emily's appendix stay three ways

lines.raw: Grouping Emily's stay (MS-DRG; what-ifs are illustrative).
lines.say: Grouping Emily's stay (M S DRG; what-ifs are illustrative).

lines.raw: Principal diagnosis. Real stay: `K35.80` acute appendicitis. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.
lines.say: Principal diagnosis. Real stay: K 3 5 . 8 0 acute appendicitis. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.

lines.raw: MDC. Real stay: Digestive system. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.
lines.say: M D C. Real stay: Digestive system. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.

lines.raw: OR procedure? Real stay: Yes: `0DTJ4ZZ` → surgical. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.
lines.say: O R procedure? Real stay: Yes: 0 D T J 4 Z Z to surgical. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.

lines.raw: Base DRG. Real stay: Appendectomy, principal diagnosis not complicated. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.
lines.say: Base D R G. Real stay: Appendectomy, principal diagnosis not complicated. What if: kidney injury already present: Same. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Same.

lines.raw: Secondary diagnoses. Real stay: None. What if: kidney injury already present: `N17.9` acute kidney failure, POA `Y` → a **CC**. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Catheter-associated urinary infection, POA `N` → an HAC, **ignored**.
lines.say: Secondary diagnoses. Real stay: None. What if: kidney injury already present: N 1 7 . 9 acute kidney failure, P O A Y to a C C. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: Catheter-associated urinary infection, P O A N to an H A C, ignored.

lines.raw: Result. Real stay: **MS-DRG 343**: Appendectomy without complicated principal diagnosis without CC/MCC. What if: kidney injury already present: **MS-DRG 342**: … with CC. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: **MS-DRG 343**: no change.
lines.say: Result. Real stay: M S DRG 343: Appendectomy without complicated principal diagnosis without CC/MCC. What if: kidney injury already present: M S DRG 342: … with C C. What if: catheter infection started in hospital: M S DRG 343: no change.

lines.raw: APR-DRG: two extra scales.
lines.say: A P R DRG: two extra scales.

lines.raw: APR-DRG (All Patient Refined DRG) groups each stay into a **base APR-DRG**, then adds two scales from 1 (minor) to 4 (extreme): **SOI (severity of illness)** and **ROM (risk of mortality, the chance of dying)**.
lines.say: A P R DRG (All Patient Refined D R G) groups each stay into a base A P R DRG, then adds two scales from 1 (minor) to 4 (extreme): S O I (severity of illness) and R O M (risk of mortality, the chance of dying).

lines.raw: It looks at how all the patient's conditions combine, not just the single worst one.
lines.say: It looks at how all the patient's conditions combine, not just the single worst one.

lines.raw: That is why many Medicaid programmes and researchers prefer it for children, pregnancy and very sick patients.
lines.say: That is why many Medicaid programmes and researchers prefer it for children, pregnancy and very sick patients.

lines.raw: Why it matters for data.
lines.say: Why it matters for data.

lines.raw: A DRG is only as good as the coding: a missing secondary diagnosis or a wrong POA flag changes the group, and so the payment and every comparison built on it.
lines.say: A D R G is only as good as the coding: a missing secondary diagnosis or a wrong P O A flag changes the group, and so the payment and every comparison built on it.

lines.raw: When you compare hospitals by DRG, remember that a hospital whose coders record every condition will have more "with CC/MCC" stays than one that codes less fully, even with the same patients.
lines.say: When you compare hospitals by D R G, remember that a hospital whose coders record every condition will have more "with CC/MCC" stays than one that codes less fully, even with the same patients.

lines.raw: Key takeaways.
lines.say: Key takeaways.

lines.raw: An MS-DRG is assigned by fixed steps: pre-MDC check, MDC from the principal diagnosis, surgical vs medical, base DRG, then severity.
lines.say: An M S DRG is assigned by fixed steps: pre-MDC check, M D C from the principal diagnosis, surgical versus medical, base D R G, then severity.

lines.raw: Secondary diagnoses on the CC or MCC lists move a stay to a higher-severity DRG.
lines.say: Secondary diagnoses on the C C or M C C lists move a stay to a higher-severity D R G.

lines.raw: POA flags matter: hospital-acquired conditions that start in hospital do not raise the DRG.
lines.say: P O A flags matter: hospital-acquired conditions that start in hospital do not raise the D R G.

lines.raw: APR-DRG adds severity of illness and risk of mortality levels from 1 to 4.
lines.say: A P R DRG adds severity of illness and risk of mortality levels from 1 to 4.

lines.raw: Pricing a DRG is a separate step (Fee For Service course).
lines.say: Pricing a D R G is a separate step (Fee For Service course).
